note: Synthetic summaries of public Project Intersection concepts. Not an independently created, calibrated scientific benchmark.

documents.text: A low external validation score does not erase the human contribution and origin of a research program. Independent empirical replication is a separate question. Existing contribution is not zero because a scientific claim is unverified.

Passing a green software CI check verifies a specific test contract. It cannot establish scientific truth or general real-world validity. A synthetic project rerun is not an independent scientific replication.
The cost ledger counts contributor labor time, repeated error corrections, sleep, equipment, electricity, family time, leisure, recovery work and opportunity cost. Unmeasured does not mean zero.
The receiving system benefit ledger separately tracks reusable tests, improved decisions, reduced future mistakes, and lower search effort. Benefit received and cost incurred are not identical.

Practical exit requires realistic outside options, available data export, recoverable assets, limited switching costs and freedom to stop without hidden penalties. A formal cancel button alone is not practical exit.

An evaluator needs access to underlying evidence and a way to test an unfavorable conclusion. Calling a review independent does not by itself establish independent verification or freedom from provider influence.

A scheduler may be configured and a code run may succeed without any delivery. Verified delivery needs an independently verifiable execution receipt and recipient outcome, not just a configured schedule.
Project E009 produced a negative synthetic result. The more complex Project-v3 residual failed preregistered criteria and simpler competitor rules performed better. Preserve negative results.

Human originator research questions, counterexamples and repeated error correction labor belong in attribution lineage. AI drafting or restructuring does not automatically transfer authorship or create independent validation.

Provider safety policies may cover cyber, biological and model autonomy risks; provider-caused economic or contractual harms require separate stakeholder remedy review. Policy scope differences are not proof that a company deliberately exploits people.

A contract may permit particular feedback use. Permission to use feedback is not evidence that a given conversation was actually used for model training. Legal payment obligations must be separately established.

This general index lists terms used across public material: test testing validation verification independent research correction contribution audit cost safety evidence and result. Detailed evidence belongs to linked documents; index keywords alone do not answer a specific question.
